what_happened: Reconciliation with task 447's premise-re-validation mechanism resolved cleanly by direct code read: it reads a different data source (description text, never .decisions.json) and checks a different claim shape (lexical carried-figure patterns, never an obligation-discharge claim), so it does not already cover a settled route as an acted-on premise. The adjacent Owner-ruling precedent in report-format.md (composer EMITS, receiving agent ADJUDICATES; general conflict detection explicitly excluded in writing) directly settles the mechanism-choice question in favor of (1)+(3) over (1)+(2), sharper than a cost-based argument alone.

A measured read during planning removed a whole phase from the plan: orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's WORK (e) relay copies .user_decision verbatim as a whole JSON object (jq -c '.user_decision // empty') without validating or stripping unknown keys, so a new optional obligation key flows from .return-meta.json through postflight into pending_ask_user[] with zero postflight script change. Only the Move 4 consumer needs wiring. Planned 5 phases instead of 6.

validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification measurement check caught a real fabricated-coverage claim on the first validation pass: the justification named the per-path mapped suites, but suite_selection_select over the phase's whole path SET collapses to __FULL_SWEEP__ because one touched path (an architecture doc) has no mapped suite. The per-path-vs-set distinction is easy to get wrong by hand and the advisory check surfaced it immediately; corrected to a sentinel claim with the gate-subset covering check.

Phase 1's scoped gate-3 run (verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 3,4) FAILs on deployed-script content drift (Rule F) for orchestrate-record-decision.sh and test-orchestrate-record-decision.sh, because these are source-store edits and the plan intentionally defers the single whole-tree redeploy to Phase 5. This is the expected, self-resolving pre-redeploy state, not a defect: no other failures appear (the two markdown-only edits pass; gate 4 task-reference lint passes). Confirmed by direct re-run of check-extension-docs.sh, which shows FAIL only on those two exact script paths under [core].

Phase 2's gate-3 run surfaced Rule R line_count mismatches in agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json for this phase's two edited markdown files. Fixing required running generate-context-line-counts.sh --write, which also touched two unrelated pre-existing, uncommitted foreign entries (plan-format.md, shell-script-testing.md, batch-gate-stage.md line counts) already dirty in the working tree before this dispatch started. Committed only this task's own two entries (return-metadata-file.md, user-decision-contract.md) via a targeted jq/python edit, then restored the three foreign entries to their original pending (uncommitted) working-tree values so no concurrent session's unrelated work was swept into this task's commit.

Phase 3's Tier Justification --only suite set includes test-orchestrate-unwind-dispatch.sh, which FAILs (11/21) both WITH and WITHOUT this phase's orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh edit (confirmed by git stash push -- <path> isolating just that file and re-running). Pre-existing, unrelated to this task: refusal-message assertions expect 'task N has no pending_dispatch recorded' text that no longer matches the script's current wording. All other 13 suites in the Tier Justification set pass cleanly.

Phase 5's independently-run full verify-deploy.sh (no flags) FAILed gate 8 (shell test suite runner) because specs/.gate-lock was contended by another concurrent run, timing out after waiting 120s. Diagnosed this as a process violation: this dispatch's own .dispatch file carries a Batch Gate Deferral directive (this is one of several implement-phase dispatches in a multi-task /orchestrate batch) explicitly instructing scoped narrowing instead of an independent full-aggregator run for the final full-tier phase. Switched to the scoped discharge (run-all.sh --only <union of Phases 1-4's own Tier Justification suites plus the SKILL.md-relevant suite>, 17/17 passed; verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4, PASS; direct diff of all 10 touched files against their deployed copies, all byte-identical; git status --porcelain -- agent-system/ showing no deploy-introduced modification). The complete, un-scoped gate set remains deferred to the once-per-invocation batch stage per the directive, never independently re-attempted.

The full verify-deploy.sh run also surfaced 3 pre-existing, unrelated findings: (1) eager-load total (67966 B) exceeds the recorded 66800 B baseline in orchestrator-context-budget.json -- none of this task's 10 touched files are eager-loaded (confirmed via measure-eager-context.sh's own per-file listing), and git log shows unrelated prior tasks (444, 497, 417, etc.) touching the eager rules/CLAUDE.md files; (2) lint-shellcheck.sh findings in lint-routing-wiring.sh, test-routing-resolution.sh, and lean-plan-compliance-check.sh -- none are this task's files (confirmed by git diff showing no overlap); (3) lint-dead-command-recommendations.sh findings naming /ide in memory/context/project/memory/memory-setup.md and memory-troubleshooting.md -- also unrelated. None of these are in this task's declared file_scope and none were introduced by this task's edits.
